messages:
ara: FYI getting alerts: mass SCIM deletes + KMS decrypt errors since 03:12 UTC. Logs show InvalidCiphertext on idp-scim-key. Anyone available? :eyes:
liam: I'm online. Paste from provisioner: ```2026-05-05T03:12:18Z ERROR scim/provisioner.go:97 kms.Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertext: failed to decrypt ciphertext for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/zzz111```
ara: We rotated that key earlier as part of routine rotation at 02:58. Did the pods reload secrets?
liam: Checking k8s secret revision now. A couple of provisioner pods still on old secret revision. Likely didn't restart after the rotation.
devops-bot: Alert: cronjob idp-cleanup started a wildcard-group purge at 03:10 — high delete volume.
ara: That explains the mass deletes. If decrypt fails, we retry -> Okta rate-limits and returns 403 on some membership deletes.
oncall: Okta shows 403 E101 Insufficient permissions on some delete requests when retries hit rate limits.
liam: Mitigation: scaling idp-cleanup to 0 and cordon the affected provisioner pods. Commands: `kubectl -n idp-prod scale deployment/idp-cleanup --replicas=0` and `kubectl -n idp-prod delete pod <stale-provisioner-pod>`
ara: Do it. Also open KMS support ticket to request the previous key version be re-enabled temporarily if needed.
liam: Scaled cleanup to 0 and restarted all provisioner pods. After restart decrypts succeeded for test payloads. Okta 403 volume decreased.
security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-072 for KMS/SCIM loop. Reminder: attach KMS ticket and RBAC PR link.
ara: I'll roll back the wildcard RBAC rule in idp-config to stop further sweeps and open a backlog for manual reconciliation.
liam: Follow-up: add runbook step to restart provisioner pods after KMS rotation and implement DLQ instead of immediate retry on decrypt failures. Created TASK-900 for DLQ.
ara: Good catch everyone. We'll keep monitoring for 30m then re-enable the cleanup job as a canary. :thumbsup:
